statement: Suppose x = PHx, ∥x∥ = 1, y ∈ ker PH, and v = QHv, ρ(v) ≤ 1, and y(v) > ∥y∥/2. For every s > 0, each of the following constructions produces an exterior test w with |y(w)| > ∥y∥/8, ρ(w) ≤ 1, ρ(f + sw)2 ≤ 1 + 3s2 , where f = PHf norms x and the inward signs are chosen with full cone budgets qg. 20 1. Take the positive and negative cumulative parts globally, choose one by its total pairing, then retain one of the two groups of cones having the same prescribed inward sign. 2. Form all four combinations of a cumulative positive/negative part and a prescribed inward-sign group, and select one by its pairing. 3. Choose a cumulative part separately in each cone, orient it inward, then retain the cones on which the resulting pairings have one common sign.
